items.titleZh: 红牛：维斯塔潘夺回第二，哈贾尔降至第五
items.summaryZh: 美国大奖赛第2圈，维斯塔潘与勒克莱尔整圈缠斗后在最后一段夺回第二，哈贾尔下滑两位至第五；赛道出现碎片，短暂出动虚拟安全车。
items.originalTitle: LAP 2/56: Frenetic start. Max tussled with Charles all lap long, reclaiming P2 in the final sector. Isack is down a couple of spots to P5, but there's...
items.summaryEn:
LAP 2/56: Frenetic start.
Max tussled with Charles all lap long, reclaiming P2 in the final sector. Isack is down a couple of spots to P5, but there's plenty of running left.
The VSC was briefly out, with debris on the track.
#F1 || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailZh: 第2圈/共56圈：开局节奏激烈。维斯塔潘整圈与勒克莱尔缠斗，在最后一段夺回第二。哈贾尔下滑几个位置至第五，但比赛还有很长距离。赛道上有碎片，虚拟安全车曾短暂出动。#F1 || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailEn:
LAP 2/56: Frenetic start.
Max tussled with Charles all lap long, reclaiming P2 in the final sector. Isack is down a couple of spots to P5, but there's plenty of running left.
The VSC was briefly out, with debris on the track.
#F1 || #USGP 🇺🇸
